title: ScipIndexContribution
description: Sealed, byte-stable handle + manifest for a raw SCIP `Index` protobuf produced by an SCIP indexer (scip-java in v1; future scip-typescript, scip-python, scip-go, rust-analyzer, scip-dotnet, ...). The protobuf blob itself lives in the BundleStore and is referenced by `nativeAttributes.blobHandle`; the contribution payload carries only its content-addressable manifest so the blackboard contribution stream stays small while the index remains seal-stable. Pattern-C universal envelope (SKILL §8bis Rule 2). PRODUCER RULE: this slot has exactly ONE producer per language (the corresponding `Scip*KS`); other KSs whose outputs *could* be expressed in SCIP (Maven/Gradle declared deps, SBOM packages, config keys) MUST NOT co-write into the same `Index.Scip` artefact -- they own their own slots and join on shared SCIP symbol ids at reduction time.

id.description: Stable client-defined identity within (panel, slot). Suggested form: '<indexerName>|<indexerVersion>|<projectRoot>|<indexedRevision>'. Used as the contribution identityKey.

indexer.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). Identifies the SCIP indexer that produced this index.

version.description: Indexer release version, verbatim from the tool.

projectRoot.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the project root the indexer was invoked on (e.g. 'src/', 'modules/api/'). MUST match the SCIP `Metadata.project_root` field of the produced index.

indexedRevision.description: Git revision (40-char SHA-1 or 64-char SHA-256) of the working tree the indexer ran on. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

languageScope.description: Set of source languages effectively covered by this index, as ISO-style identifiers ('java', 'kotlin', 'scala', 'typescript', 'python', 'go', 'rust', 'csharp', ...). Empty when the indexer is single-language and the language is implied by `indexer.name`.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Carries the content-addressable handle to the raw `.scip` protobuf and its manifest. Tool-specific extras (e.g. indexer warnings count, partial-index flag) also live here.

blobHandle.description: Content-addressable URI of the raw `.scip` protobuf in the BundleStore (e.g. 'bb://blackboard/runs/{bbId}/bundles/scip/<sha256>.scip'). Consumers stream `Document` messages from this handle.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw `.scip` protobuf bytes. Anchors byte-stability of this contribution across re-seals.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes of the raw `.scip` protobuf.

documentCount.description: Number of SCIP `Document` messages in the index. Diagnostic only; does not participate in identity.

symbolCount.description: Number of SCIP `SymbolInformation` records in the index. Diagnostic only.

externalSymbolCount.description: Number of `external_symbols` entries (cross-package references). Diagnostic only.

occurrenceCount.description: Number of SCIP `Occurrence` records across all documents. Diagnostic only.

partial.description: True when the indexer reported a partial/degraded run (e.g. some files failed to compile). Consumers MAY still process the index but SHOULD downweight downstream confidence.

scipProtocolVersion.description: Verbatim SCIP `Metadata.version` (ProtocolVersion enum, e.g. 'UnspecifiedProtocolVersion'). Replay-diagnostic only.

textDocumentEncoding.description: Verbatim SCIP `Metadata.text_document_encoding` ('UTF8' | 'UTF16' | 'UnspecifiedTextEncoding'). Distinct from per-document `position_encoding` carried on `Index.ScipDocument.positionEncoding`.

indexerArguments.description: Verbatim SCIP `Metadata.tool_info.arguments[]`. Indexer CLI arguments, useful for reproducibility/replay diagnostics.
